what: A plugin/preset display string (est.json name, vendor, description, license, feature, parameter name, preset name) carrying an invisible or format character. EST-M018 claims to refuse zero-width and direction characters; the original ranges (U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069) missed these, so a name could carry hidden text or read identically to another in the store card, Home, the Browser and the admin review queue.
harm: Name impersonation / hidden text in Cyber's own surfaces (not code execution: names render as text).
missedCodePoints: U+E0000..U+E007F Tags block (encodes an invisible ASCII string)
